items.title: Steve "Ted" Brown Interview, 1958-04-22
items.q: That's Spiegel Wilcox, see. Beautiful tone there.

ctx.x: That's the last record that they made. That's Biggs. That's Joe Benuti playing violin. Now, in the choruses, when I slap the bass, you'll notice a difference. See, it's a difference in the way they're playing now, see? See, they just... They pick the bass and they don't let the strings hit, see? They just get the tone. But I used to do that. I used to slap it to get a rhythm at the tempo. Mm-hm. But I used to do that, I used to slap it to get a rhythm at the time. I think I'm boring that, I'm not sure. That's Big…

I heard those on the high five. Boy that bass comes out loud as hell. You can hear it there too. That's Spiegel Wilcox, see. Beautiful tone there. I knew that clarinet play. He's dead now. Yeah. Yeah. Oh no. On this particular record. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm. Mm-hm.
